headlines.title: How Investors Are Reacting To Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP) $2b Share Sale
headlines.summary: Keurig Dr Pepper completed a US$2b follow on equity offering of about 57,971,015 common shares at US$34.50 each, with proceeds allocated to repaying or repurchasing outstanding debt ahead of a planned split into two listed companies. The move shifts part of the capital structure from borrowings to equity, which affects leverage targets, earnings per share calculations, and flexibility for the upcoming Beverage Co and Global Coffee Co separation.

headlines.title: Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP) Raises $2b In Equity, Is The Stock Fully Valued?
headlines.summary: Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP) has just completed a follow on equity offering of about $2 billion, issuing roughly 58 million common shares at $34.50 each to support its upcoming corporate split. description: Keurig Dr Pepper Inc. owns, manufactures, and distributors beverages and single serve brewing systems in the United States and internationally. The company operates through three segments: U.S. Refreshment Beverages, U.S. Coffee, and International. It manufactures and distributes branded concentrates, syrup, and finished beverages, as well as sales of owned brands and third-party brands; tea, cocoa, and other products; and offers finished goods relating to K-Cup pods, single serve brewers, specialty coffee, and ready to drink coffee products. The company offers its products under the Dr Pepper, Canada Dry, Mott's, A&W, Peñafiel, GHOST, Snapple, 7UP, Green Mountain Coffee Roasters, Clamato, Core Hydration, The Original Donut Shop, Sunkist soda, Squirt, C4 Energy, Hawaiian Punch, Electrolit, Bloom, Bai, Evian, Yoo-Hoo, Vita Coco, Big Red, RC Cola, Crush, McCafé, Tim Hortons, Van Houtte, Celestial Seasonings, Bigelow, Starbucks, Dunkin', Folgers, Peet's, and Swiss Miss brands, as well as other partner and private label brands. It markets and sells its products to supermarkets, mass merchandisers, club stores, e-commerce retailers, office superstores, vending machines, fountains, grocery and drug stores, convenience stores, and other small outlets; and directly to consumers through Keurig.com website. Keurig Dr Pepper Inc. was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Frisco, Texas.
